items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: and the drummer, Bill Clark and my bass player, they were running to the checkroom with me after a while.

ctx.x: and the drummer, Bill Clark and my bass player, they were running to the checkroom with me after a while. I guess they thought something bad was going to happen and I was trying to get to the checkroom. I did this for about 3 weeks and after a while Sy, Sy Baron, that was his name (he's a lovely cat) said to me, "Mary, you're going to have to come out of that checkroom." "I'm not, I'm not." So he finally coaxed me out and I sat with the people. I'd sit in the corner as if I was having a chill. It's just terrible…
When you say he was with you there what do you mean?
